title: Behind shed
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：behind　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 behind 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the clerk kept the stamp ① behind the war at the counter, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the stamp had been left ② behind the door of the shed, and nobody had asked a single question. The clerk had come to the office two months earlier and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The file for May 1962 puts it plainer. It was done ③ behind the quiet of the house, and the applicant who kept the stamp had signed it ④ behind the back of the shop twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done behind the quiet of the house in those days. The applicant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ behind the quarrel, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ behind the times; he was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was that the stamp be signed ⑦ behind the wall of the yard, and that the names be written ⑧ behind the words of the letter. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried behind the wall of the yard.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978 she kept the stamp ⑨ behind the war again when nobody else would, and ⑩ behind the door of the shed, she said in 1980, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the stamp in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot what had been done behind the door of the shed.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…后面（表时间：behind the war）
B. prep. 在…后面（表处所：behind the door of the shed）
C. prep. 落后于（表方式／状态：behind the quiet of the house）
D. prep. 落后于（引出施动者或相关的人：be signed behind the back of the shop）
E. prep. 在…后面（表原因：behind the quarrel）
F. prep. 落后于（表对象／目的：behind the times）
G. prep. 在…后面（表工具／材料：behind the wall of the yard）
H. prep. 落后于（表载体／处所：written behind the words of the letter）

items.q: behind the door of the shed
behind the quiet of the house
behind the back of the shop
behind the wall of the yard
behind the words of the letter
behind the door of the shed, she said

answers.why: behind 意为“在…后面”，此处引出时间 the war（战后），说明那件小小的印章是在何时留下的。
behind 意为“在…后面”，此处引出处所 the door of the shed（棚屋的门后），说明东西被放在何处。
behind 意为“落后于”，此处引出方式或状态 the quiet of the house（屋里的安静），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
behind 意为“落后于”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 铺子的后间：be signed behind the back of the shop。
behind 意为“在…后面”，此处引出原因 the quarrel（那场争吵），说明整件事由何而起。
behind 意为“落后于”，此处引出对象或目的 the times（时势）。
behind 意为“在…后面”，此处引出工具或材料 the wall of the yard（院墙后面）。
behind 意为“落后于”，此处引出载体 the words of the letter（信里的字句）：names written behind the words of the letter。
behind 意为“在…后面”，1978 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的印章，此处仍引出时间 the war。
behind 意为“在…后面”，母亲 1980 年那句话引出的仍是那一处棚屋的门后。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年战后前后，书记员把那件小小的印章留在了窗口。（behind the war）
那件小小的印章被放在棚屋的门后，谁也没有过问。（behind the door of the shed）
整件事是屋里的安静做成的，卷宗上写得明白。（behind the quiet of the house）
入冬之前，那件小小的印章已经由铺子的后间签过两回。（be signed behind the back of the shop）
叔叔说，整件事是由那场争吵起的。（behind the quarrel）
他说，家里从来没有人为时势做过这件事。（behind the times）
answers: In 1968 the clerk kept the stamp behind the war at the counter.
The stamp had been left behind the door of the shed, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done behind the quiet of the house, or so the file says.
The stamp had been signed behind the back of the shop twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun behind the quarrel.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it behind the times.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 behind 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the clerk kept the stamp behind the war, and nobody forgot it.
The stamp had been left behind the door of the shed for three months.
The work was done behind the quiet of the house, as it always was in those days.
The stamp had been signed behind the back of the shop twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the stamp behind the war again when nobody else would.
The whole office never forgot what had been done behind the door of the shed.
